full_name: Rob Verchick | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2023–2024 Law Frances B. Cashin Fellow Loyola University New Orleans Tulane University
bio: Rob Verchick is a legal scholar in climate change and disaster policy who designed climate-resilience programs in the Obama administration; the Gauthier-St. Martin Eminent Scholar and Chair in Environmental Law at Loyola University New Orleans; and a senior fellow in disaster resilience at Tulane University.
